tier: post-hoc diagnosis on the spent I3 R set (60 Claude-authored requests, adjudicated Claude-agent reference); C1 re-run read-only on a copy of the live store with the frozen build; class assignment by Claude (single annotator), never held-out

classes.in_knowledge: a primary family is taught and registered
classes.non_purchase_stored_alternative: primary remedy needs no purchase and a matching *_alternative concept exists in the store under some category
classes.non_purchase_absent: primary remedy needs no purchase and the store holds nothing matching
classes.family_held_unreachable: primary family is taught in the store but not registered (tumble dryers) or documented in an owner package never translated (soundbars, speakers, robot cleaners)
classes.family_absent: primary family is unknown to PEE in any form
classes.no_family_needed: no primary family: vague, gift, nothing fits

hypothesisScore.note: C1 hypothesis scores; median of justified vs invented hypotheses
